title: Associate  Tax Advisor
description_text:
Our client is seeking to recruit an Associate Tax Advisor to join a dynamic team. The successful applicant will be part of the tax section and provide tax services to a diverse local and international client base.
 Responsibilities: 
 Assisting clients in the areas of direct taxes.
 Preparing written tax opinions as required by clients.
 Supporting tax compliance work, including Income Tax Returns and Claims for Refund.
 Liaising with auditors on tax matters.
 Advising and assisting clients on their fiscal obligations and compliance within prescribed time limits.
 Advising clients on the most tax-efficient structuring of their corporate and personal tax affairs.
 Assisting private clients with fiscal obligations under various Tax Residency Schemes.
 Ensuring client needs and expectations are met efficiently and professionally.
 Requirements: 
 ACCA qualification or equivalent.
 At least 12 years of relevant experience.
 Knowledge of local and international tax matters.
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Maltese; knowledge of Italian is an asset.
 Benefits: 
 Attractive salary package.
 Excellent work-life balance.
 Supportive environment and transparent career path.
 Don't miss this opportunity to advance your career in a fast-growing, dynamic environment.
